Riociguat (Adempas) is imported as tablets in dosage form, so it falls in heading 3004 (medicaments in measured doses). Riociguat is a pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine with a pyrimidine ring: methyl N-[4,6-diamino-2-[1-[(2-fluorophenyl)methyl]-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridin-3-yl]pyrimidin-5-yl]-N-methylcarbamate. It has a pyrimidine ring, so it is a candidate for 3004.90.92 or a similar subheading. HTS 3004.90.92 is "Other: Other" and 3004.90.9290 is a statistical suffix, so I'll check the alternatives.

The 3004.90 breakdown is:
- 3004.90.10 contains specific items.
- 3004.90.20 covers other medicaments with certain ingredients.
- 3004.90.91 is "Other: Other" (Other: Other, for example hormones).
- 3004.90.92 is "Other: Other".

Many pharmaceutical products like this are classified under 3004.90.9290.

The chosen code is 3004.90.9290.
